method: Each archived payload member was decompressed, CRC checked by the ZIP reader, and compared with its exact byte count and SHA256 in the payload manifest. Every duplicate-image original path was independently matched to the same exact stored payload. The manifest itself was compared byte for byte. This receipt was then appended and the complete ZIP CRC tested again.
final_zip_sha256_location: Returned by the packager after the final CRC pass and supplied with the download; not embedded in the archive whose bytes it hashes.
